units.source_text: 自轉、公轉、反轉是它的自由隨處感受到至高無上的力量

en.t: Its rotations, revolutions, and reversals are its own freedom; everywhere one senses a supreme power.

units.source_text: 所有的國家，所有的民族都不乏相同的人性

en.t: In every country and every people, the same humanity is never lacking.
Am I the only one who is different?

units.source_text: 世人都誤讀了聖訓否則也不會有常識和智慧

en.t: People have all misread the sacred teachings; otherwise they would have common sense and wisdom.

units.source_text: 嚴禁肉體之樂，也禁止酒沾口脣算了，穆斯塔法，最讓我忌恨

en.t: They strictly forbid bodily pleasure, and even forbid wine from touching the lips. Enough, Mustafa; that is what I hate most.

units.source_text: 可那時，卻有一位勸我戒酒的少女。

en.t: But at that time, there was a young woman who urged me to stop drinking.

units.source_text: 「你這樣可不行啊，每天睜開眼就喝得醉醺醺的。」

en.t: "You cannot go on like this, getting drunk every day as soon as you open your eyes."

units.source_text: 她是小酒館對面那家香菸店老闆的女兒，年方十七八歲，

en.t: She was the daughter of the owner of the tobacco shop opposite the little bar, about seventeen or eighteen years old,

units.source_text: 名字叫良子，面板白皙，長著虎牙。

en.t: Her name was Yoshiko; she had fair skin and little snaggle teeth.

units.source_text: 每次我去買菸時，她都會笑著忠告我。

en.t: Whenever I went to buy cigarettes, she would smile and warn me.

units.source_text: 「為什麼不行呢？哪裡不好？有酒就得喝。

en.t: "Why is it wrong? What is bad about it? If there is liquor, you have to drink it.
